headword: {医薬分業|いやくぶんぎょう}

definitions.gloss: separation of prescribing and dispensing of medicine
definitions.explanation: The system in which a doctor writes a prescription but the medicine is dispensed separately by a pharmacy, rather than being handed out at the clinic. It is the standard arrangement in modern Japanese healthcare.

examples.japanese: {医薬分業|いやくぶんぎょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: The separation of prescribing and dispensing is progressing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{医薬分業|いやくぶんぎょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}→一般的：04784_ippanteki⟧になった。
examples.english: The separation of prescribing and dispensing has become common in Japan too.

examples.japanese: {医薬分業|いやくぶんぎょう}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧、⟦{薬剤師|やくざいし}→薬剤師：07030_yakuzaishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{処方|しょほう}→処方：05976_shohou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}できる→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to the separation of prescribing and dispensing, pharmacists can double-check the contents of a prescription.

notes:
Refers to the institutional split between the doctor who prescribes (⟦{処方|しょほう}→処方：05976_shohou⟧) and the pharmacist who dispenses (⟦{調剤|ちょうざい}→調剤：18821_chouzai⟧) a medicine. The aim is to have a second professional check each prescription for errors and drug interactions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {医薬分業|いやくぶんぎょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧: the separation advances
- {医薬分業|いやくぶんぎょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体制|たいせい}→体制：04490_taisei⟧: a system of separated prescribing and dispensing
- ⟦{院外|いんがい}{処方|しょほう}→院外処方：29878_ingaishohou⟧: an outside prescription (filled at a separate pharmacy)
